segments.text: PLEASE!
I'll race you to the raft! Ready! Go!
Look at the clouds, Emily! They look so beautiful, little bear. I think I see a giant
woolly beetle. Where? Right above us. You mean the one that looks like an Indian
chief. That's not an Indian chief. Now it looks like a ballerina. It looks more like an elephant to me.
Duck, can you see the one I need? The big goose Aheela? No, it's a beautiful big castle.
Cat, hen, owl. It's such a hot day. Why don't you come out here on the raft? I can't swim! I can swim if I have to. But I don't have to. I'm quite comfortable where I am. Thank you.
Little bear, little bear!
Oh dear, don't we need this for something? Maybe we should swim back to shore. No, this will be fun. Here. Put this on. What about you? I'm a bear. I practically live in the water. Oh well.

Little bear, where are you going? We're going rafting on the river, I guess. That river is too slow. You'll be drifting forever. You'll never make it back in time for lunch. Oh yes we will. We'll race you to the big tree. A race? How exciting.
On your marks, get set. Go! We're already going.
Come on, owl. The others are ahead of us. Can we go faster little bear? I'm trying.
Run!
Look, we're already way ahead of them. I knew that river was slow. And I know a shortcut. Follow me.
This is so lovely. Oh little bear. Isn't rafting wonderful? Oh yes. Wonderful.
Little bear, what are you doing? I got the pole stuck. Oh my!
How can we go faster without the pole? I don't think we can. We'll just have to go where the river takes us.
I'm not too fond of your shortcut. Oh come on, it'll be fine.
Oh!
Some shortcut that was. The others are ahead of us now. I'm tired. There was so many branches and thorns.
We just went in a big circle. It was a very good shortcut. You two just didn't go fast enough. That's all.
Oh dear.
Oh!
Rats!
We're really stuck.
We're going to win this race very easily. Maybe we should have a rest. After all, it is very hot.
That's much better.
We're going to lose the race if we don't get going.
And miss lunch. Hello little bear. Emily. Duck. It's the otters. Hello otters.
What are you doing on this beautiful day? Come in first swim. Well that would be nice, but we're in the middle of a race.
A race? Don't you think you should pick up the pace? Well yes, but we're stuck on this rock. Don't worry.
We'll get you unstuck with a flip and a flat.
Oh! What wonderful swimmers they are. Thank you otters. You're welcome.
But this is going to take you all day. We can show you a faster way.
Hold on tight. Hold on to your head.
I don't have a hat.
Oh!
Look, the others are way ahead of us.
However did they do that? Come on we have to hurry.
Look little bear. There's the big tree. We're almost there.
Thank you otters. That was a wonderful ride. Good bye. Good bye.
There's the raft. We've got up to them. Can we slow down now? No no we're almost there.
Look I can see the big tree. If we go the long way around we'll never win the race.
Hmm we need a shortcut. Not another one of your shortcuts.
Look! If owl can get that rope we can swing over to the other side.
We won't even get our feet wet.
I can't see. Look it's cat and cat and owl.
Whoa!
I don't like swimming.
Neither do I.
And we've lost the race.
No you haven't. It's a tie because we've all finished together.
Yeah!
Yeah!
